items.headline: Pill succeeds in two late-stage trials for a sight-threatening eye inflammation
items.summary: Brepocitinib, a daily pill, cut treatment failure to about a third of patients versus nearly four in five on placebo across two phase three trials in non-infectious uveitis.
items.why_it_matters: Uveitis is a leading cause of preventable blindness, and current options rely heavily on steroids with serious side effects.
